beats.text: Why do GPUs sit idle during LLM inference until The Open-Book Exam Revolution unlocks 98.2% throughput?
beats.visual_focus: A glowing neural network skull stuffed with millions of floating Wikipedia books until its circuits spark and overload.

visual_blueprint.title: THE PARAMETRIC MEMORY TRAP
visual_blueprint.sub: Forcing neural weights to memorize encyclopedic knowledge

beats.text: Parametric weights rot over time. When facts change. You must burn millions of dollars retraining them. Worse, they confidently hallucinate.
beats.visual_focus: A frozen set of weights glowing red while an incoming question about modern events causes corrupt glitch tokens to spill out.

visual_blueprint.title: STATIC WEIGHT DILEMMA
visual_blueprint.sub: Weights cannot update without full re-training

motif_params.title: STATIC WEIGHT DILEMMA
motif_params.sub: Weights cannot update without full re-training

beats.text: Enter RAG. Retrieval-Augmented Generation. Instead of closed-book memorization. The model gets an open-book search engine plugged directly into its brain.
beats.visual_focus: The model splits into two interacting halves: a neural generator paired with an external high-speed dense vector index.

beats.text: A dense vector retriever queries Wikipedia passages in real time. The neural generator conditions either per-sequence or dynamically token-by-token.
beats.visual_focus: Mathematical query vectors shooting down into Wikipedia embeddings, extracting top-k documents that route directly into the token probability stream.
